Display Panel.name: Indium
Display Panel.reasoning: Used in transparent conductive oxides such as indium tin oxide (ITO) for touch and display electrodes; industry standard.

Display Panel.name: Silicon
Display Panel.reasoning: Used in driver ICs and backplane transistors; core semiconductor material though sometimes compound semiconductors are used.

Display Panel.name: Aluminum
Display Panel.reasoning: Utilized in thin films and coatings within display layers for electrode contacts and reflective surfaces; common but alternatives exist.

Display Panel.name: Gallium
Display Panel.reasoning: Used in compound semiconductors in some display technologies (e.g. gallium arsenide or gallium nitride); not universal but important in higher-end displays.

Cpu Module.name: Silicon
Cpu Module.reasoning: Core semiconductor material for CPU chips; absolutely essential and defines the CPU module.

Cpu Module.name: Copper
Cpu Module.reasoning: Used for internal wiring and heat sinks; excellent electrical and thermal conductor critical for CPU performance.

Cpu Module.name: Aluminum
Cpu Module.reasoning: Used in heat sinks and chip packaging; very common due to thermal conductivity and lightweight properties.

Cpu Module.name: Gold
Cpu Module.reasoning: Used in thin wire bonding and contacts for its excellent corrosion resistance and conductivity; common but alternatives such as copper bonds exist.

Cpu Module.name: Silicon dioxide
Cpu Module.reasoning: Used as insulation and gate oxide layers in transistors forming the integrated circuit structure; essential dielectric material.

Keyboard.name: Polycarbonate
Keyboard.reasoning: Common polymer for keycaps and plastic components due to toughness and transparency; standard material though ABS is also used.

Keyboard.name: Copper
Keyboard.reasoning: Used in conductive traces for key matrix circuits; common choice due to good conductivity.

Keyboard.name: Silicon
Keyboard.reasoning: Used in membrane switches or small IC chips for keyboards; common semiconductor material but some keyboards use rubber or other materials for tactile feedback.

Keyboard.name: Aluminum
Keyboard.reasoning: Used for keyboard backplates or frames in premium designs; optional but common for rigidity.

Laptop Chassis.name: Aluminum
Laptop Chassis.reasoning: Widely used metal for chassis due to light weight and mechanical strength; very common choice in premium laptops.

Laptop Chassis.name: Magnesium
Laptop Chassis.reasoning: Used in some laptop chassis alloys for lightweight and strength; less common but important in certain models.

Laptop Chassis.name: Polycarbonate
Laptop Chassis.reasoning: Used in plastic chassis parts or combined with metal for weight reduction and durability; alternatives exist but common polymer.

Laptop Chassis.name: Steel Ingots
Laptop Chassis.reasoning: Sometimes used in internal frame elements for strength; not universal but present in some laptop designs.

Cooling Fan.name: Aluminum
Cooling Fan.reasoning: Used for fan blades and heat dissipation parts due to light weight and thermal conductivity; common but plastics are alternatives.

Cooling Fan.name: Copper
Cooling Fan.reasoning: Used in motor windings and heat dissipation components; common electrical conductor though some cheaper fans use aluminum or other metals.

Cooling Fan.name: Polypropylene
Cooling Fan.reasoning: Plastic material used in fan blade construction in many models; alternatives include other polymers but widely used.

Cooling Fan.name: Steel Ingots
Cooling Fan.reasoning: Used in motor shafts and structural parts due to strength; common but alternatives include other steels or alloys.

Power Adapter (external Charger).name: Copper
Power Adapter (external Charger).reasoning: Essential for internal wiring and transformer windings due to excellent electrical conductivity; universal in power adapters.

Power Adapter (external Charger).name: Aluminum
Power Adapter (external Charger).reasoning: Used in heat sinks and casing parts; common but some adapters use other metals or plastics.

Power Adapter (external Charger).name: Silicon
Power Adapter (external Charger).reasoning: Used in semiconductors such as diodes and controllers within the adapter; fundamental electronic component.

Touchpad.name: Glass
Touchpad.reasoning: Used as smooth touch surface in many modern touchpads; provides durability and sensitivity; alternatives include plastic but glass is premium.

Touchpad.name: Copper
Touchpad.reasoning: Used for conductive traces and electrodes in the touch sensor; common choice due to conductivity.

Touchpad.name: Silicon
Touchpad.reasoning: Used in integrated circuits controlling touch detection; standard semiconductor material.

Touchpad.name: Polycarbonate
Touchpad.reasoning: Used in housing and backing structures for durability; common polymer but alternatives exist.

Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.name: Silicon
Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.reasoning: Primary semiconductor in NAND flash memory chips and controller ICs; absolutely essential.

Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.name: Copper
Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.reasoning: Used for circuit interconnections and PCB traces; standard conductive material in SSDs.

Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.name: Aluminum
Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.reasoning: Used in heat spreaders and casing elements; common but alternatives present.

Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.name: Glass
Solid State Drive (ssd) Module.reasoning: Used in packaging components and substrate insulation; not always used but common.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Lithium
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Key element in lithium-ion battery chemistry providing energy storage; absolutely essential with no substitutes.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Cobalt
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Common cathode material improving energy density and stability; typical in many Li-ion cells although lithium iron phosphate (LFP) is an alternative.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Copper
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Used as current collector in anodes and electrical conductor internally; universally used.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Aluminum
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Used as cathode current collector and casing; widespread industry standard.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Graphite
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Primary anode material enabling lithium intercalation; critical and standard in commercial Li-ion batteries.
